name: a first boot goes straight into confirmed, turns the cursor live and checks the digest
a boot records a thin dead derived row as a spent id and keeps it out of confirmed
a boot over confirmed rows fills staging and leaves confirmed as it was
staging replaces the confirmed rows and their digest when the boot cursor turns live
a page requested under an older cursor is dropped as stale
reset sets the cursor to null and keeps the confirmed rows for the next boot
gone forgets the scope and resolves its acked entries; its pending entries stay
not-found marks the scope known not-found
live rows replace confirmed rows, a dead row deletes and a new row enters
a live row older than the confirmed row is ignored; a newer one replaces
a page ending inside a seq resolves acked entries only through the seq before it
the page that finishes the seq resolves the rest
a boot that ends resolves acked entries through its asOf
a tree whose board create is still in the outbox is not pulled; once the create has its result, the tree boots
a not-found frame for a tree whose board create is still in the outbox is ignored: commits into it are accepted, a pull of it alone sends nothing, and it boots once the create has its result
a not-found the server wrote before the board's create, landing after the create is acked, is ignored: commits into the tree are accepted
not-found frames for a tree and its overlay whose board create is acked are ignored: commits into the tree are accepted
a not-found frame for a tree whose board is confirmed alive is ignored: the replica holds the board, so the answer is stale
a not-found frame for a tree whose board has a held delete waiting is ignored: the board is dead in drawn but alive in stored
an ok whose seq the frame before it already applied resolves in its own transaction
a digest mismatch at the head emits telemetry and resets the scope
the boot after a mismatch reset restores the rows and its check matches
a mismatch on the first check after a mismatch reset stops checks at this app version
stopped checks skip at the same app version and resume at a new one
a tree pulled alone under a credential that resolves to no account is answered 401: the replica pauses and forgets nothing
a not-found page for a product scope is ignored: its rows and cursor stay, and nothing is recorded known
a gone frame for a product scope is ignored
a subscribe clears a known scope: a commit to it is accepted, and its first pull boots it
a subscribe to a scope known gone answers gone and keeps the record: its death is final, so a commit to it refuses scope-dead
the next frame with rows applies inline and checks the digest
a frame past the next seq asks for a pull
a frame without rows asks for a pull
a frame of another epoch asks for a pull
a change frame served as anonymous is a 401: sync pauses and the frame applies nothing
a change frame served as another account is a 401: sync pauses and the frame applies nothing
a gone frame forgets the scope
its product scope, pulled alone and served as anonymous, is a 401: sync pauses, and its rows, cursor and known record stay
its own private tree, pulled alone and served as anonymous, is a 401: sync pauses, and its rows, cursor and known record stay
its overlay of a public tree, pulled alone and served as anonymous, is a 401: sync pauses, and its rows, cursor and known record stay
a public tree, pulled alone and served as anonymous, is a 401: sync pauses, and its rows, cursor and known record stay
a pull served as another account is a 401: its page, a reset against that account's scope, applies nothing
not-found frames served as anonymous, as a socket without a credential answers a sub, pause sync and forget nothing
an alive governing row in a page clears its tree's and overlay's not-found records, so the tree is subscribed and pulled again
an alive governing row in a frame, a create another replica re-sent, clears its tree's and overlay's not-found records
a response of a new epoch changes epoch first, and its pages, requested under old cursors, are stale
a live page short of its head leaves the scope behind: the next frame asks for a pull, since a row changed twice is not yet in its state at the cursor, and the pull to the head clears it
after a death between chunks the scope is behind: a frame of the next seq, relayed late to a new socket, asks for a pull instead of applying over rows past the cursor
a live page applied one row a chunk leaves what the page applied whole leaves, and its last chunk checks the digest

a process death between chunks of a live page keeps the rows applied, digest with them, and the cursor where it was; the acked entry the page covers stays acked, and a reader sees the page as if it ended at the last row applied
the live page a death cut short, pulled again under the unmoved cursor, applies to the same end: the acked entry resolves and the check matches
a death in the first page of a boot straight in leaves its rows under a null cursor; the boot pulled again goes into staging, and its swap drops a row deleted since
a death between chunks of a boot into staging leaves confirmed as it was; the boot pulled again from null starts its staging afresh, so a row deleted since is not swapped in
a death between chunks of a later boot page keeps the boot cursor; the boot goes on at its asOf, and a row changed since arrives live
a death that cuts a page short applies none of the pages after it
a rows page for a tree whose board died while it was in flight is outside the subscription set: it applies nothing, and the tree stays known gone with no rows and no cursor
inside a held delete's window the board's tree stays in the subscription set: a not-found for it is ignored, and a reconcile keeps its rows
a boot answered after a sign-out applies nothing: the dormant replica stays purged, and the anon replica takes no rows
